svg.text: Measured MicroK8s temperature and fan-command response
Node CPU thermal sensor samples; Fan resource values are requested commands, not measured RPM or PWM voltage.
Max sensor reading: 55.1°C on raspi-51; the loaded node raspi-41 peaked at 50.147°C.
